properties.name: Francois Imbeau
properties.summary: Quarter section beginning opposite the upper end of Wright Daniel’s farm, near Little Rock.
properties.note: Article 7 named this tract first. This point marks an approximate mid-tract location on the south side of the Arkansas River.

properties.name: Joseph Duchassin
properties.summary: Quarter section immediately downriver from the tract granted to Francois Imbeau.
properties.note: Article 7 named this tract second. This point marks an approximate mid-tract location on the south side of the Arkansas River.

properties.name: Saracen (Sarassin)
properties.summary: 80-acre tract including his improvement, opposite Vaugine’s; explicitly identified in the treaty as a “half breed Quapaw.”
properties.note: Saracen is also listed among the treaty signatories. This point marks an approximate mid-tract location.
